paper: APPSC Group-I Preliminary (Screening Test) 2023, Notification 28/2022, Paper II – General Aptitude (GS/1G/101), Part B only (Science & Technology; Current Events), held 08-01-2023

questions.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India’s Anti-Satellite Missile test :
I. The test successfully destroyed a live satellite in Low Earth Orbit.
II. The test was done in the upper atmosphere to ensure that there is no space debris.
III. India is the fourth country in the world to have this kind of missile system.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: Mission Shakti (2019) destroyed a live satellite in low Earth orbit, making India the fourth country with this capability; it was done at a low altitude (about 300 km) so debris would decay, not in the upper atmosphere to avoid debris.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Recently, NITI Aayog approved a proposal to conduct a study on the use of facial recognition technology in India. In the context of facial recognition technology, consider the following statements :
I. A National Automated Facial Recognition System (NAFRS) is being developed by the National Informatics Centre, under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
II. The biggest demerit of facial recognition technology is its limitation in identifying people in real-time and not in photos and videos.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: As per the official key, neither statement is correct: the AFRS is being developed by the NCRB under the Home Ministry, and facial recognition does work in real time as well as on photos and videos.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements regarding ExoMars :
I. Its rover will be the first mission to combine the capability to move across the surface and to study Mars at depth.
II. ExoMars is a joint programme of the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Russian Space Agency – Roscosmos.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: The Rosalind Franklin rover of ExoMars would be the first to both move across Mars and drill to study it at depth, and ExoMars was planned as a joint ESA-Roscosmos programme.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Fast Breeder Reactors :
I. Fast Breeder Reactors are designed to breed more fuel than they consume.
II. In this reactor, Plutonium-239 undergoes fission to produce energy, while the Uranium-238 present in the fuel transmutes to additional Plutonium-239.
III. It is a part of stage 1 of India’s Nuclear power programme.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: Fast breeder reactors breed more fissile fuel than they consume, with Pu-239 fissioning while U-238 transmutes to Pu-239; they form stage 2, not stage 1, of India's nuclear programme.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements about International Nitrogen Initiative (INI) :
I. It is set up under sponsorship of the Scientific Committee on Problems of the Environment (SCOPE) and United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).
II. Its key objective is to optimize nitrogen’s beneficial role in sustainable food production.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: As per the official key, only II is correct: the INI aims to optimise nitrogen's beneficial role in food production; it was set up by SCOPE and the International Geosphere-Biosphere Programme.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Nationally Determined Contributions Transport Initiative for Asia (NDCTIA) :
I. It is an ASEAN initiative that aims to facilitate a paradigm shift to zero emission transport across Asia.
II. The Indian component of the initiative is implemented by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change in partnership with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: As per the official key, neither is correct: NDC-TIA is a joint project of seven organisations funded by Germany's IKI (not ASEAN), and its Indian component is led by NITI Aayog.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited (IREDA) :
I. It is a Navratna Enterprise of Government of India.
II. It aims to give financial support to schemes for generating electricity through new and renewable sources and conserving energy through energy efficiency.
III. It works directly under the administrative control of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: IREDA is a Mini Ratna (Category I) PSU, not a Navratna, under the administrative control of MNRE, and it finances renewable energy and energy-efficiency projects.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The Renewables Integration in India 2021 report was launched by which of the following institutions ?
o: NITI Aayog and International Energy Agency
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy and Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
International Solar Alliance and Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
questions.x: The 'Renewables Integration in India 2021' report was released jointly by NITI Aayog and the International Energy Agency.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to the enrichment of Uranium :
I. Uranium enrichment refers to increasing the percentage of U-238 (the fissile isotope) through the process of isotope separation.
II. Weapons-grade Uranium has to be enriched to a maximum of 20 percent of the fissile isotope.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: Enrichment raises the share of U-235, not U-238, and weapons-grade uranium needs about 90 percent U-235, so neither statement is correct.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
With reference to Digital Embossing Technology, consider the following statements :
I. It is a printing technology that does not use chemicals, solvents and also emits no pollutants.
II. It can be used to produce braille maps for the visually challenged.
III. It was introduced in India recently by the National Atlas & Thematic Mapping Organisation (NATMO) functioning as the Attached Office of the Department of Science & Technology.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: NATMO's digital embossing is a chemical-free, pollution-free printing technique that is being used to make braille maps for the visually challenged.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
With reference to ISRO’s upcoming mission “Shukrayaan-I”, consider the following statements :
I. Shukrayaan is India’s first mission to Saturn to study the planet’s surface and atmosphere.
II. The satellite is planned to be launched onboard the GSLV Mk III rocket.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: Shukrayaan-I is a planned mission to Venus, not Saturn, so statement I is wrong; the key also treats II as wrong, so the answer is none of the above.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
With reference to RFID Technology, consider the following statements :
I. Passive RFID tags are powered by an internal circuit and utilize it to send response to the reader.
II. Semi-passive RFID tags comprise an internal circuit with power source but rely on radio waves received from the reader to transmit the response.
III. Active RFID tags acquire their power from the readers’ incoming radio waves.
IV. RFID Technology can scan a tag as long as it is within frequency range and it does not have any line-of-sight limitations.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: Passive tags take power from the reader's radio waves and active tags have their own battery, so I and III are wrong; semi-passive tags and the lack of line-of-sight needs are correctly described.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements :
I. Dark Reserve is a public or private land with a distinguished nocturnal environment and starry nights that has been developed responsibly to prevent light pollution.
II. World’s 1st International Dark Sky Reserve is Mont-Megantic, located in Russia.
III. The International Dark-Sky Association (IDSA) is a EU-based non-profit organisation that designates sites as international dark sky places.
IV. The Department of Science & Technology (DST) has announced the setting up of India’s 1st Dark-Sky Reserve in Himachal Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: As per the official key, none of the given combinations is right: Mont-Megantic is in Canada, the IDA is US-based, and India's first dark sky reserve (Hanle) is in Ladakh, not Himachal Pradesh.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to Sampurnanand Telescope :
I. It is located at Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences (ARIES), Ladakh.
II. It has completed 50 years of operations.
III. It has been extensively used for optical observations of comets, star forming regions and star clusters.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: The Sampurnanand Telescope at ARIES, Nainital (not Ladakh) completed 50 years in 2022 and has been widely used for optical observations of comets, star-forming regions and clusters.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to Dirty Bomb :
I. It is a bomb that contains radioactive material, such as uranium, which is scattered through the air when its conventional explosive detonates.
II. It creates city-flattening atomic explosion and less toxic waste.
III. Manufacturing dirty bombs is costlier than nuclear weapons.
Which of the statements given above are incorrect ?
questions.x: A dirty bomb spreads radioactive material with conventional explosives; it does not cause an atomic explosion and is far cheaper than a nuclear weapon, so II and III are incorrect.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to “Gaganyaan” :
I. Gaganyaan is an Indian crewed orbital spacecraft intended to be the formative spacecraft of the Indian Human Spaceflight Programme.
II. ISRO announced Vyommitra, a Male Robot who will accompany other astronauts in the mission.
III. The crewed vehicle is planned to be launched on ISRO’s GSLV Mk II.
IV. Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) will provide support for critical human-centric systems and technologies in this mission.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: Gaganyaan is India's first crewed orbital spacecraft and DRDO supports its human-centric systems; Vyommitra is a female humanoid robot and the launcher is the human-rated LVM3 (GSLV Mk III).
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to “Small satellite launch vehicle” designed by ISRO :
I. It can place a 500 kg payload at a height of 500 km in the Low Earth Orbit (LEO).
II. It has two solid motor stages with a lift off mass of 100 tonnes.
III. It is shorter in length than the PSLV and GSLV.
IV. Unlike the PSLV and GSLV, it can be assembled both vertically and horizontally.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: The SSLV can place 500 kg in a 500 km orbit, is shorter than PSLV and GSLV and can be assembled vertically or horizontally; it has three solid stages and a lift-off mass of about 120 tonnes.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to “International Space Station” :
I. It is a multinational collaborative project between five participating space agencies i.e., NASA (USA), Roscosmos (Russia), ESA (Europe), JAXA (Japan) and ISRO (India).
II. It is the only active modular space station (habitable artificial satellite) in the Low Earth Orbit (LEO).
III. It has been functional since 1998.
IV. The ownership and use of the space station are established by intergovernmental treaties and agreements.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: The ISS is the only active modular station in LEO, operational since 1998 (first module), governed by intergovernmental agreements; ISRO is not one of its five partner agencies (CSA of Canada is).
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Which of the following Schemes/Programmes are launched with the objective of reversing India’s brain drain to brain gain ?
I. VAJRA Scheme
II. Ramanujan Fellowship Programme
III. INSPIRE Scheme
IV. ASEAN – India Research Training Fellowship Scheme
Select the correct answer from below :
questions.x: VAJRA, the Ramanujan Fellowship and INSPIRE aim to attract scientists to work in India and reverse brain drain; the ASEAN-India fellowship is a cooperation programme.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Indian Council for Medical Research (ICMR) developed the strategic plan and Vision 2030 document based on the following :
I. Strengthen health research capacity in the country
II. Leverage traditional medicine
III. Well aligned with the National Health Policy NHP-2017
Select the correct answer from below :
questions.x: ICMR's strategic plan and Vision 2030 aim to strengthen health research capacity, leverage traditional medicine and align with the National Health Policy 2017.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
A joint programme of DRDO and ISRO, developed highly potent Anti-Satellite Weapons (ASAT) under Mission Shakti.
I. ASAT is a missile-based system to attack moving satellites.
II. India, using ASAT Missile, destroyed a live satellite in Low Earth Orbit.
III. ASAT missile is capable of shooting down targets moving at a speed of 50 km per second at an altitude as high as 2000 km.
Which of the statements regarding ASAT are true ?
questions.x: As per the official key, ASAT is a missile-based system to destroy moving satellites and it destroyed a live satellite in LEO; III overstates its speed and altitude.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Which of the following events has delayed the commissioning of the Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant ?
I. Disintegration of the USSR
II. India’s economic crisis of 1991
III. Protests by Civil Society
Select the correct answer from below :
questions.x: As per the official key, the Kudankulam plant (1988 Indo-Soviet agreement) was delayed by the break-up of the USSR and by civil society protests.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
With reference to a mega project pertaining to Nuclear Fusion research that is being built in Southern France, International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER), consider the following statements :
I. It was designed to demonstrate the scientific and technological feasibility of fusion power for peaceful use.
II. Institute of Plasma Research (IPR), Gandhinagar is the Nodal agency for the project ITER.
III. ADITYA is a medium size Tokamak fusion reactor installed at IPR, Gandhinagar as part of ITER.
IV. EU, India, China, Japan, South Korea, Russia and US are the members of ITER.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: ITER in southern France aims to prove fusion power for peaceful use; IPR Gandhinagar is the nodal agency (ITER-India), ADITYA is a tokamak at IPR, and EU, India, China, Japan, Korea, Russia and US are members.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
With reference to “Blockchain Technology”, consider the following statements :
I. It is a public ledger that everyone can inspect, but no single user controls.
II. The structure and design of blockchain is such that all the data in it are about cryptocurrency only.
III. Applications that depend on basic features of blockchain can be developed without anybody’s permission.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: Blockchain is a public ledger nobody singly controls, and permissionless applications can be built on it; it is not limited to cryptocurrency data.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: In India 3D-Printed Cornea and 3D-Printed Liver Tissue were developed respectively by
o: Aravind Eye Hospital and Panacea Biotec Ltd
L.V. Prasad Eye Institute and Biocon Limited
L.V. Prasad Eye Institute and Pandorum Technologies
Centre for Sight and SIRO Clinpharm
questions.x: L.V. Prasad Eye Institute developed India's first 3D-printed cornea, and Pandorum Technologies 3D-printed liver tissue.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: In the reduced or microgravity of Space, the astronauts’ faces become red and bloated due to the blood and cerebrospinal fluid shifting towards the head causing them to have round, puffy faces and thinner legs. This phenomenon is known as
questions.x: The puffy face and thin legs seen in microgravity, caused by fluid shifting to the head, is popularly called the Charlie Brown effect.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Identify the incorrect statement about the e-Governance programmes in India.
o: DARPAN is an online tool that can be used to monitor and analyse the implementation of critical projects of the State.
KHAJANE is an e-Governance project for the computerized delivery of land records to farmers of Karnataka.
Jeevan Pramaan is an Aadhaar-based Biometric Authentication System for pensioners.
e-PRAGATI has been aimed at starting a culture of pro-active governance and timely implementation.
questions.x: Karnataka's Khajane is an online treasury (government payments) system; land records are handled by Bhoomi, so statement 2 is incorrect.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
“Cheetahs have been reintroduced in India.” Which of the following connected to the above statement are correct ?
I. Cheetahs will help in the restoration of open forest and grassland system.
II. Project Cheetah is the world’s first inter-continental large wild carnivore translocation project.
III. Out of 8 Namibian wild Cheetahs reintroduced into Kuno National Park, 5 are male and 3 are female.
IV. The Cheetahs indigenous to India that went extinct, are African Cheetahs.
V. Author of “The End of a Trail – The Cheetah in India” is Divyabhanusinh.
questions.x: Cheetahs help restore open forest and grassland, Project Cheetah is the first inter-continental translocation of a large carnivore, and Divyabhanusinh wrote 'The End of a Trail'; of the 8 Namibian cheetahs 5 were female and 3 male, and India's extinct cheetah was the Asiatic one.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: A fermentation process that uses ultrasound to safely generate Xylitol from Sugarcane bagasse is created by
o: Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research, Lucknow
questions.x: IIT Guwahati developed an ultrasound-assisted fermentation process to make xylitol from sugarcane bagasse.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Identify the incorrect statement about Hydrogen Fuel Cell Bus developed in India :
I. India’s first indigenously developed Hydrogen Fuel Cell Bus was developed by Veera Vahana Company.
II. The fuel cell employed in the Hydrogen-powered Bus will combine Hydrogen and Carbon dioxide to create electricity.
III. The effluent from the hydrogen-powered Bus is water and heat instead of smoke.
questions.x: As per the official key, I and II are incorrect: India's first indigenous hydrogen fuel cell bus was developed by KPIT and CSIR, and a fuel cell combines hydrogen with oxygen, not carbon dioxide.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Pick out the correct matches from the following statements regarding externally-aided projects in Andhra Pradesh :
I. Andhra Pradesh Integrated Irrigation and Agriculture Transformation Project is aided by the World Bank.
II. Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming (APCNF) is aided by Japan International Co-operation Agency (JICA).
III. Andhra Pradesh Irrigation and Livelihood Improvement Project Phase-3 is aided by KfW – German Bank.
o: Only II and III are correct
Only I and III are correct
questions.x: As per the official key, only the World Bank-aided AP Integrated Irrigation and Agriculture Transformation Project is matched correctly.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding status of Andhra Pradesh Aquaculture ?
I. ‘YSR Matsyakara Bharosa’ relief is provided to marine fishermen families during fishing ban period.
II. Andhra Pradesh Fisheries University is to be established in East Godavari District.
III. The Diesel Oil Subsidy for fishermen boats is associated with exemption of sales tax on HSD oil.
IV. The Government has enhanced the financial benefit to deceased fishermen (while fishing) family from ₹ 5 lakhs to ₹ 10 lakhs.
o: Only I, II and III are correct
Only I and II are correct
Only III and IV are correct
Only I, III and IV are correct
questions.x: As per the official key, I, III and IV are correct: YSR Matsyakara Bharosa ban-period relief, the diesel subsidy tied to sales tax exemption on HSD oil, and ex gratia raised from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh; the fisheries university is in West Godavari.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Which of the following statements are correct about Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor Development Program (VCICDP) ?
I. It is partly funded by loan from Asian Development Bank (ADB).
II. It is aligned with the Golden Quadrilateral and covers more than 800 km of the State of Andhra Pradesh’s coastline.
III. It is a node-centric development platform comprising four nodes.
IV. Donakonda is recognized as one of the nodes.
o: Only I and II are correct
Only II and III are correct
Only I, II and IV are correct
Only I, III and IV are correct
questions.x: The VCIC is AP's part of the East Coast Economic Corridor, funded partly by ADB loans, aligned with the Golden Quadrilateral along over 800 km of coast, and Donakonda is one of its nodes.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Which of the following statements are correct about the Sea Ports in the State of Andhra Pradesh ?
I. GoAP has recently declared Krishnapatnam Port as a Major Port.
II. Kakinada SEZ Port is being converted from captive port to commercial port through Swiss Challenge Approach.
III. GoAP has declared Nakkapalli Port as a Minor Port.
IV. Vodarevu Port is being developed on Build, Own, Operate and Transfer (BOOT) basis.
o: Only I, III and IV are correct
Only II, III and IV are correct
Only II and III are correct
Only III and IV are correct
questions.x: As per the official key, II, III and IV are correct: Kakinada SEZ port conversion under the Swiss Challenge route, Nakkapalli declared a minor port and Vodarevu on BOOT basis; Krishnapatnam is not a major port.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following minorities have been allotted special budget cover (2021 – 22) by the Government of Andhra Pradesh ?
questions.x: In the 2021-22 AP budget, a special budget cover was given to the Dudekula Muslim minority.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Which of the following statements are valid regarding the initiatives taken by the Andhra Pradesh Government in Women Development and Child Welfare Department ?
I. Government in collaboration with PRATHAM organization is building the capacitites of supervisors and anganwadi workers.
II. Government in collaboration with UK CATAPULT organization is extending support for funding the YSR Thalli Bidda Express.
III. ‘YSR Sampoorna Poshana Plus +’ scheme provides nutritional support to pregnant women and lactating mothers in all the mandals except the 77 Scheduled and Tribals sub-mandals.
IV. Poshan Abhiyaan is implemented in the State by a 50% external aid from IBRD.
o: Only I and III are correct
Only I, III and IV are correct
Only I and IV are correct
questions.x: As per the official key, statements I and IV are correct.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following statements regarding the investments in Andhra Pradesh at World Economic Forum (WEF) 2022 is incorrect ?
o: ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel (AMNS) announced an investment of ₹ 1,000 crores to expand its pellet plant capacity in Visakhapatnam.
Government of Andhra Pradesh signed an MOU with Aurobindo Realty & Infrastructure Private Limited for generating 6000 MW of Green Energy.
Government of Andhra Pradesh signed an MOU with Greenko Group for generating 8000 MW of Green Power.
Government of Andhra Pradesh signed an MOU with ACE Urban Developers for setting up a Pumps and Compressor manufacturing unit at Mega Industrial Park at Kopparthy, YSR Kadapa district.
questions.x: As per the official key, the statement about ACE Urban Developers and a pumps and compressor unit at Kopparthy is the incorrect one.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: In the recent times which of the following bird had mass mortality at Telineelapuram Important Bird Area (IBA) of Srikakulam district ?
questions.x: Spot-billed pelicans (Pelecanus philippensis) died in large numbers at Telineelapuram in Srikakulam district.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Which of the following statements are correct with regard to Swachh Survekshan Awards 2022 ?
I. Visakhapatnam was awarded ‘Top Impact Creator’ under Million Plus City category.
II. Tirupati Municipal Corporation won the first rank in ‘Safaimitra Suraksha Seher’.
III. Salur was awarded for innovation and best practices under South zone for towns with 50,000 to one lakh population.
IV. Pulivendula was awarded for innovation and best practices under South zone for towns with 25,000 to 50,000 population.
V. Vijayawada Municipal Corporation was awarded as cleanest capital.
questions.x: In Swachh Survekshan 2022, Visakhapatnam won 'Top Impact Creator', Tirupati won the 'Safaimitra Suraksha' award and Vijayawada was cleanest State capital, so I, II and V are correct.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Consider the following statements :
I. Andhra Pradesh Official Language (Amendment) Act, 2022 Bill was introduced in the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly on 23rd March, 2022.
II. Urdu language, as the second official language in all the districts of Andhra Pradesh came into force on 25th April, 2022.
III. Urdu language was already the second official language in Nellore, Anantapur, Guntur, Chittoor and Kadapa of United Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the above statements is/are incorrect ?
questions.x: As per the official key, only II is incorrect, so the other statements about the AP Official Language (Amendment) Act, 2022 are treated as correct.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Match the following List I with List II with regard to Arjuna Awards 2022 :
Name of Sportsperson   Discipline
a. Sushila Devi   i. Shooting
b. Omprakash Mitharwal   ii. Weightlifting
c. Vikas Thakur   iii. Para Badminton
d. Tarun Dhillon   iv. Deaf Badminton
e. Jerlin Anika J.   v. Judo
questions.x: Arjuna Awards 2022: Sushila Devi (judo), Omprakash Mitharwal (shooting), Vikas Thakur (weightlifting), Tarun Dhillon (para badminton), Jerlin Anika J. (deaf badminton).
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Identify the correct statements about the Prime Minister’s Development Initiative for North East Region (PM-DevINE).
I. It was announced in the Union Budget 2022 – 23 to address developmental gaps in the North Eastern Region (NER).
II. PM-DevINE is an addition to the quantum of resources available for the development of the North Eastern Region and will not be a substitute for existing Central and State Schemes.
III. It enables livelihood activities for the youth and women of North Eastern Region.
IV. PM-DevINE will fund infrastructure convergently, in the spirit of PM Gati Shakti.
questions.x: PM-DevINE was announced in Budget 2022-23 as extra funding for the North East (not a substitute for existing schemes), to support livelihoods for youth and women and fund infrastructure in the spirit of PM Gati Shakti.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Consider the following statements, with reference to e-RUPI :
I. It is a seamless one-time payment mechanism.
II. It is powered by NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India).
III. It was developed with the support of DFS (Department of Financial Services) and NHA (National Health Authority).
IV. It was launched in the year 2020.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: e-RUPI is a cashless one-time payment voucher developed by NPCI with DFS and the National Health Authority; it was launched in August 2021, not 2020.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with respect to the “Satkosia Tiger Reserve” :
I. It is a Tiger Reserve located in Odisha.
II. It comprises two adjoining Sanctuaries of Central Odisha, named the Satkosia Gorge Sanctuary and the Debrigarh Sanctuary.
III. It is located in the Eastern Ghats where Mahanadi river flows through a deep gorge.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: Satkosia Tiger Reserve in Odisha combines the Satkosia Gorge and Baisipalli sanctuaries (not Debrigarh), where the Mahanadi cuts a gorge through the Eastern Ghats.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to the “Crimson Rose Butterfly” :
I. It is categorised as ‘Endangered’ as per the IUCN Red List.
II. It is most common in the Himalayan regions, like Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.x: The Crimson Rose is listed as Least Concern by the IUCN and is common in peninsular India, so neither statement is correct.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 :
I. The Act empowers authorities like the Director to attach property believed to be “proceeds of crime”.
II. Offences under Part A of the Schedule deal with trans-border crimes and reflect the dedication to tackle money laundering across the global boundaries.
III. The Act and the Rules notified thereunder came into force with effect from 2005.
IV. The Act has provided for an Appellate Tribunal and Special Court to conduct the trial of the offences of money laundering.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: PMLA allows the Director to attach proceeds of crime, came into force in 2005 and provides an Appellate Tribunal and Special Courts; Part B of the Schedule, not Part A, covers cross-border crimes.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to Vande Bharat Express :
I. It is semi-high speed electric multiple unit train operated by Indian Railways.
II. The first Vande Bharat train was manufactured by Integral Coach Factory, Chennai.
III. It can achieve maximum speed of 250 kmph, reducing journey time.
IV. It was previously known as Train 18.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: Vande Bharat (earlier Train 18) is a semi-high-speed EMU built by ICF Chennai; its design top speed is 180 km/h, not 250 km/h.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Consider the following statements about “Vikram-S” :
I. It is India’s first privately built rocket.
II. It is a single stage suborbital space launch vehicle.
III. The mission for the rocket launch has been named as “Prarambh”, meaning beginning.
IV. It was developed by space tech startup Agnikul Cosmos.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: As per the official key, I, II and III are correct: Vikram-S was India's first privately built rocket, a single-stage suborbital vehicle, launched in the 'Prarambh' mission; it was built by Skyroot Aerospace.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Consider the following statements about “National War Memorial” :
I. It was inaugurated in 2021.
II. The eternal flame of Amar Jawan Jyoti underneath India Gate was put out and merged with another eternal flame at the National War Memorial.
III. It was built to commemorate all the soldiers who have laid down their lives in the various battles, wars, operations and conflicts of Independent India.
IV. The architecture of the memorial is based on four concentric circles.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: The Amar Jawan Jyoti flame was merged with the National War Memorial flame, the memorial honours soldiers who died after Independence and has four concentric circles; it was inaugurated in 2019.

questions.s:
Recently, the Prime Minister of India led tributes to freedom fighter Velu Nachiyar on her 292nd birth anniversary. With reference to Rani Velu Nachiyar, which of the following statements is/are correct ?
I. She was the first queen to wage a war against the East India Company.
II. She formed an alliance with Tipu Sultan against the British in 1780.
Select the correct answer using the code given below :
questions.x: Rani Velu Nachiyar was the first Indian queen to wage war against the East India Company; she allied with Hyder Ali (not Tipu Sultan).

Consider the following statements with reference to Agriculture Orientation Index (AOI) :
I. It is published by The International Food Policy Research Institute.
II. It measures the country’s progress towards SDG-2 (End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition).
III. It is calculated as the percentage of the Government’s expenditure on agriculture, divided by the share of agriculture in the GDP.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: The AOI is the government's agriculture expenditure share divided by agriculture's share in GDP and tracks SDG 2; it is published by the FAO, not IFPRI.

questions.s:
Which of the following statements is correct with reference to the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) ?
I. SWIFT is a global member-owned cooperative that is headquartered in Switzerland.
II. SWIFT was founded in 1991.
III. SWIFT is a payment network.
IV. SWIFT has the authority to impose sanctions on the banks.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: As per the official key, none of the given combinations is correct: SWIFT is a Belgium-based cooperative founded in 1973, it is a messaging network rather than a payment network, and it cannot impose sanctions.

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to China’s Chang’e 5 lunar probe :
I. It is named after the Chinese Moon goddess.
II. It is China’s first attempt at a sample-return mission.
III. It will be the first probe to bring back material from the Moon, since NASA’s Luna 24 mission.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: Chang'e 5 is named after the Chinese moon goddess and was China's first sample-return mission; Luna 24 was a Soviet mission, not NASA's.

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to Conference of Parties (COP27) :
I. COP27 was held in Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt.
II. COP27 reiterated the goal set by the Paris Agreement at COP21 which was to keep global warming from rising more than 1.5 degrees Celsius from the 2000s.
III. The previous Conference of Parties (COP26) was held in Glasgow, Scotland.
IV. COP27 reached agreement to provide “loss and damage” funding for vulnerable countries hit hard by climate disasters.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: COP27 was held at Sharm el-Sheikh, the previous COP26 was in Glasgow and COP27 agreed on a loss and damage fund; the 1.5 degree goal is measured from pre-industrial levels, not the 2000s.

questions.s:
Consider the following statements with reference to Mangrove Alliance for Climate (MAC) :
I. The launch of Mangrove Alliance for Climate (MAC) is spearheaded by United Arab Emirates in partnership with Indonesia.
II. Australia, Japan, United States, Canada, Sri Lanka and India are members of MAC.
III. It was launched at the Conference of Parties (COP27) summit.
IV. It is an intergovernmental alliance with no binding targets.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.x: As per the official key, I, III and IV are correct: MAC was launched by the UAE with Indonesia at COP27 as a non-binding intergovernmental alliance; the United States and Canada were not among its founding members.
